thesis: The speakers discuss Benchmark Capital's unique equal partnership structure designed to compete with Kleiner Perkins by offering partners equal economic stakes rather than junior roles. They explain that this model required founders to leave if they could not work 110% to ensure the firm built a legacy rather than allowing senior partners to capture the economics while junior partners generated returns.
